overview_description.description:
Jamble is a fashion resale platform that enables users to buy and sell used clothing. They provide resellers with video and live streaming technologies to help them sell more efficiently, as well as purchasers with a unique and appealing experience.

Jamble is headquartered in San Francisco, California and was founded in 2021.
